summary.headline: Apollo Micro Q1 FY27 standalone revenue rose 17% YoY to INR156 crores, while consolidated revenue jumped 88% to INR251 crores; standalone PAT up 43% to INR28 crores.
summary.overview: Management reported its best June quarter, with standalone revenue of INR156 crores (+17% YoY), EBITDA incl. other income of about INR48 crores, and PAT of INR28 crores, giving record EBITDA and PAT margins of 31% and 18%. Consolidated revenue was INR251 crores (+88% YoY) and consolidated EBITDA excluding other income was INR54 crores (+31%). Management pointed to a standalone order book of INR1,224 crores and a consolidated order book of INR1,704 crores as of 8 August 2026. The company also signed to acquire a 41.33% promoter stake in Premier Explosives for about INR1,550 crores in cash, and reiterated 40-45% growth guidance.

segments.name: Standalone Apollo Micro Systems
segments.commentary: Revenue INR156 crores (+17% YoY) with PAT of INR28 crores and 18% PAT margin, the highest June-quarter PAT. Export revenue is nil.

segments.name: Ideal Explosives (subsidiary)
segments.commentary: Turned PAT positive in Q1 FY27 after being EBITDA positive in Q4 FY26, but margins are thin. Management expects full positive contribution from FY28 after 3-4 quarters of restructuring; order book is INR480 crores.

segments.name: Premier Explosives (proposed)
segments.commentary: Acquisition of 41.33% promoter stake for about INR1,550 crores, all cash; open offer timing is with the regulator. Not yet consolidated.

guidance_outlook: Revenue growth of 40-45% continues to be guided for FY27, on both consolidated and standalone bases; management declined to give EBITDA margin guidance.
FY28 guidance to be given at the end of FY27.
Consolidated order book expected to reach INR3,500-4,000 crores by end FY27 on the back of a single order of INR2,500-3,000 crores (understood to be MIGM/QRSAM-linked, not confirmed).
Ideal Explosives expected to be fully positive from FY28.
Export orders expected to be meaningful in FY27 but not guided; next FY seen as sizable. Export revenue is excluded from guidance.
Promoter pledge expected to be fully cleared in about one year (around Q1 FY28).
capex_capacity: Unit III is a large facility; first phase production has started and full production is expected before March 2027. Management says operational readiness is expected in the next couple of quarters.
Plans for new production plants at Ideal and Premier are to be announced in the next 2-3 months, with the broader plan to follow once Unit III is fully operational (around December).
Autonomy segment investment to be heavy in FY27 and FY28 across land, air and sea.
Aerial bombs (1 kg to 25 kg) established, with 9 variants tested and acceptance received.
Management plans to acquire 2-3 more companies; MoUs to be signed before announcements.
demand_pricing: QRSAM: BEL to take the order soon, with a missile portion to BDL. BDL order value expected at INR11,000-12,000 crores; first phase 1,000 numbers. Apollo content is more than INR1 crore per missile across about 5 sub-systems. Execution starts in FY28.

MIGM: DAC approval received; Navy inquiry expected end of next month; purchase order expected December-January. Total budget about INR3,500 crores, 20% advance, and management expects about 70% share. Execution over about 3 years, with production starting FY28.
Pinaka: 2,000 numbers under negotiation; Apollo component about INR85 lakhs per Pinaka.
Akash-NG: 1,000 numbers cleared by MoD; component value similar to QRSAM (more than INR1 crore).
HAL: current orders about INR100-150 crores, with another INR150 crores expected.
Moored mines: combat trials done; DCP and contract expected; orders expected next FY. Limpet mines: trials complete, orders possible from Q4 FY27.
Kusha: 150 km version tested; Apollo supplied about 7 critical sub-systems. Conversion to orders expected in 2-3 years.
Anti-drone Make-II: trials not yet started; TAM guidance expected around December quarter.
SAVIOR ASW: Make-II prototype sanction; customer expects completion in 18 months, with orders about a year later.
IPREC (IAF Make-II): Apollo is prime development agency; conversion of dumb bombs to precision guided bombs.

qa_highlights.question: How will Premier Explosives be integrated and what synergies arise?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Premier gives backward integration into propulsion and explosives, removing dependence on third parties (e.g. MIL) and enabling Apollo to become a prime OEM for weapons. Operations will remain separate for now; Ideal will not merge with Premier.

qa_highlights.question: Will Ideal's losses be resolved, and when will it integrate into defence?
qa_highlights.answer: Ideal is PAT positive in Q1 but margins are low. Bulk explosives volumes are weak; GOCL accessories manufacturing starts in a couple of quarters. Full positivity expected from FY28. Integration plan to come in 2-3 months.

qa_highlights.question: Is there any FY27 or FY28 revenue or EBITDA margin guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Growth guidance of 40-45% is reaffirmed for FY27. No EBITDA margin guidance; management said the momentum will continue, with FY28 guidance at year-end.

qa_highlights.question: Order book trajectory for three years including Premier?
qa_highlights.answer: Consolidated order book is INR1,700 crores; a single order of INR2,500-3,000 crores expected by FY27-end could take it to INR3,500-4,000 crores. Premier's own order book was not disclosed as it is in the CCI process.

qa_highlights.question: How is the INR2,500 crore acquisition funding deployed?
qa_highlights.answer: Around INR2,500 crores for the acquisition, around INR500 crores for working capital debt, with the rest for general corporate purposes.

qa_highlights.question: What is R&D as a percentage of revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management initially said about 4% for FY26, then corrected it: FY26 R&D was INR72.53 crores on INR764 crores revenue, around 9.5%, with a 6-8% average over the last 3-4 years.
